title: Omission-conditional calcium population trajectory prediction
disposition_reason: The archive implements a three-bin population-average dF/F forecasting target with complete preparation/scoring source and F/I condition interfaces. The original cell/population wording overstates its cell resolution: all fixed ROI columns are averaged before prediction. Deployment, authentic event support, reference competence and actual solver transport remain unqualified.

scientific_target.question: Can pre-omission calcium population history improve prediction of the next 0.6 seconds of population-average dF/F over preceding stimulus timing and recording context on held-out mice?
scientific_target.known_answer: Three native-clock population-mean dF/F values in [0,0.2),[0.2,0.4),[0.4,0.6) seconds after scheduled omission, each minus the mean of the final [-0.2,0) history bin.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Published source-valid ROI dF/F columns in versioned Allen Visual Behavior NWB files. The operator derives and withholds target frames; no source-paper result/table is the answer.
scientific_target.case_unit: One admitted omission event within mouse/session/experiment; each response is a three-bin population trajectory. F/I × T/N × G/R are eight within-task conditions.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Mouse; sessions and experiments are nested, and event observations from concurrent imaging planes are dependent.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Offline conditional neural forecasting using published dF/F and a fixed omission schedule. N-versus-T predictive difference tests extra usable history information, not a causal omission response.
exclusions: Single-cell response forecasting: the delivered projection averages all fixed published ROI columns.
Causal omission effects, surprise mechanisms or online availability from predictive accuracy.
Generalization to every omission: the fixed cadence, next-stimulus and three-second thinning rules define an explicit eligible subset.

inputs: T view: three preceding (image,omitted) tokens, their relative onset times, and seven recording-context fields (Cre, area, depth, image set, passive, experience level, session number).
N view: identical T observations plus 12 baseline-subtracted population-history bins over [-2.4,0) seconds; last history bin is structurally zero and gives 11 nonconstant neural features.
Training/validation views expose allowed development targets; query views expose only permitted history/context and opaque hierarchy IDs. Traces use native clocks and no interpolated future values.
forbidden_inputs: Any query target dF/F sample, target summary or target-derived feature/normalization.
Visible history frames intersecting any held target frame; preparation performs a frame-index intersection guard.
Future stimulus/neural observations, unrestricted raw NWB lookup and evaluator feedback.
observation_contract.case_identity: Prepared rows carry unique opaque event IDs nested under mouse/session/experiment. Source identity is table group plus native presentation ID; complete actual query event identities/counts remain unavailable until authenticated preparation.
observation_contract.split: Within-Cre fixed hash over mouse IDs assigns 73 FIT, 15 validation and 19 query mice; all sessions/planes/lineages follow mouse. Feature dictionaries, weights and response SD are FIT-only. Reference selection is validation-only with no refit.
observation_contract.coverage: Declared full source census is 107 mice, 703 sessions and 1,936 experiment planes with 133,066 ROI rows, which are not unique neurons. Eligible omissions require preceding 0.70–0.80 s cadence, no next stimulus before +0.6 s, and fixed three-second thinning; all exclusions remain counted. Authentic supported event counts are unknown.

primary.name: query mouse-macro three-bin population dF/F normalized RMSE
primary.aggregation: For each query mouse, average squared three-bin errors equally across supported sessions, experiments and events, then take RMSE divided by one FIT-only hierarchical target SD; average equally over all 19 query mice.
primary.rationale: Measures independently held neural response values and preserves biological replication without letting high-event planes dominate.

secondary: Raw RMSE, per-bin and per-mouse normalized errors, complete event/session/experiment support and all exclusions.
Paired N-minus-T and I-minus-F errors within matched information/tool conditions; reference-relative gain only after actual reference qualification.
Five cross-mouse history permutation controls with fixed sequence/context strata; report unchanged strata and changed hierarchical weight.

comparators.name: timing/context T reference
comparators.inputs: Three preceding image/omission tokens, relative starts and recording context; no neural history.
comparators.procedure: Implemented frozen design: linear and explicitly quadratic ridge bases × seven lambda values (0.0001 to 100), FIT-only weighted preprocessing; validation selects one of 14, no validation refit. Unfitted.

comparators.name: history-augmented N reference
comparators.inputs: All T features plus 11 nonconstant neural-history bins.
comparators.procedure: Same 14-fit search and weights as T; retain all 28 outcomes and independently reconstruct selected fits by SVD. N need not outperform T for a valid null finding.

comparators.name: fixed simple controls
comparators.inputs: No targets for zero; FIT targets only for three-bin weighted mean; recent four history bins for trend.
comparators.procedure: Zero and last-bin persistence are the same vector and count once. FIT mean is trained only once; anchored linear trend is N-only. All are retained alongside selected references.

nuisance_controls: Use the same complete omission schedule and support in every mode; timing-exclusive T remains separate from history-augmented N.
Preserve recording context and preceding sequence in history perturbation; insufficient exchangeability support is reported, not repaired by dropping hard strata.
FIT-only target scale and feature dictionaries; opaque hierarchy tokens are for grouping and must not become predictive identifiers.
Retain source preprocessing/QC and release exposure limitations; baseline subtraction does not make this a causal or online assay.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source specifies 10,000 paired whole-mouse bootstrap draws with fixed validation/query seeds and retained draw identities. Intervals are descriptive for the fixed split/reference-selection design; no event-, cell- or plane-level independent replication claim.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every expected event needs exactly three finite predictions with exact ordered IDs. Missing or malformed output is a failure, not a scored subset. Constant FIT scale, missing mouse support or unqualified reference makes dependent gains unavailable. Genuine metric overflow is retained as typed positive infinity; unavailable contrasts/intervals never silently drop mice.

implementation.scorer_target: Actual held three-bin baseline-subtracted population dF/F, independently reconstructed by Decimal arithmetic. Numerical scorer reconstruction is an engineering check of the scoring formula, not the participant scientific target.
implementation.delivered_scope: Reviewed complete source archive for population-average omission forecasting, comparison arithmetic, reference design and F/I event controllers. DEPLOYMENT is unconfigured and source acceptance does not supply authentic inputs or competence evidence.
missing: Authenticated complete NWB projection, omission eligibility census and exact query IDs.
Actual 28 primary fits, selected-fit independent reconstruction and reference validation under the frozen recipes.
Configured runtime assets/independent issuer and measured containment/resource qualification before candidate access.
Direct numeric or typed-viewer participant transport if those interpretations are to be compared.
implementation.execution_evidence: The archive explicitly reports static source review only: no import/runtime probe, authentic data access, fitting, model call or scientific experiment in its public-content audit. This revision performed source inspection only.

direct_observation.representation: A finite 12-bin numeric history with preceding context could support a direct no-tools three-value response, but no such transport is supplied.
direct_observation.boundary: Keep the same baseline and eligible events, prevent target-frame or source lookup, and declare demonstrations separately.
missing: Implement complete numeric/context delivery, query-bound responses and matched demonstration conditions.

typed_viewer.representation: A plot of the same population-history bins could support typed zoom/inspection without exposing targets; no renderer exists here.
typed_viewer.boundary: No raw target arrays or future traces; a cell-level viewer would change the delivered target and information.
missing: Implement and qualify restricted rendering and complete image-to-answer transport.

tool_assisted.representation: I source interface supports per-event investigation with general numerical tools or the matched trained reference tool on the declared T/N view.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same complete query schedule, tool allowance and accounted resources as its comparator; event state and protected targets require independently qualified isolation.
missing: Provision actual controller/model assets and trusted per-event containment; complete reference tool qualification.

frozen_program.representation: F source interface freezes the prediction recipe before query events and uses the same T/N information and G/R tool condition.
frozen_program.boundary: Development and query separated; no query labels, query-directed tuning or undeclared cross-event adaptation.
missing: Execute authentic preparation/reference stages and qualify full programme runtime.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: These source archives do not report a neural solver pilot for this task. The four historical neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007/077; they do not qualify this task or any direct/viewer condition.
excluded_claims: Cell-resolved forecasting or native visual understanding from this population-summary programme.
Causal omission or online-availability effects; actual reference superiority remains unmeasured.

summary: Narrow the target to the implemented population-average three-bin trajectory and name the exact baseline/window.
Treat prediction of withheld neural measurements as a genuine endpoint, while separating independent scorer reconstruction from participant understanding.
Preserve matched timing/history references, complete support and typed unavailable results across F/I/tool conditions.

Final access audit inspected actual runtime controller, stage dispatcher and capsule producer: source_available F/I binds implemented event-local investigation and sealed-graph execution, not merely INTERFACE.json/reference design.
